item.title: Eaton grad nominated for an Oscar
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA — Preble County residents preparing to watch the 2026 Oscars on Sunday, March 15, should add the short film “The Singers” to their must watch list. Nominated under the “Best Live-Action Short” category, “The Singers” was directed by Sam Davis and produced by Jack Piatt. item.description: CEDARVILLE — Brandon Stover woke up in a hospital after an 18-hour seizure and didn’t recognize his father.
